Lighting/mood: Warm natural daylight, blue sky, peaceful and inviting.
Constraints: Stylized educational illustration. No readable text or letters, UI, flags, logos, watermark, postcard frame or stamp. No Colosseum, giant intact temple, unrelated landmark or invented geography.
inspection: Inspected original PNG. Semicircular tiered pale-stone theatre, open orchestra and low ruins among lush greenery beside lagoon; no Colosseum. Painterly style matches reference. No readable text/UI/flags/logos. Seating extends beyond central 75% horizontally; root reviewed and accepted with contain sizing. Stylized scenic view.
